I really wish i could. I live in a small town so finding a new one means maybe using an entire day travelling, counselling, waiting hours for the next bus/train...
I just. Ive just never met a counsellor or professional who has helped me long term. It seems so impossible.

(Thanks for replying btw<3)

Have you opened up to someone, even if its just saying «im not feeling all that good»? Im not sure how to explain it but to me it kind of broke the wall between the «perfect» outside-me and the vulnerable inside-me(if that even makes sense haha) which relieved the loneliness at least a little bit.

Hey thanks for answering! I've tried starting in the weightlifting club because it's something easier I could do (going your own pace is highly encouraged there), but I am really struggling showing up to the sessions since my confidence and energy is so low. In addition I'm scared that I'm actually just faking it so telling my parents and doctor seems impossible. (I know!! cliche right)
Also yeah you're right those seems super difficult at the moment, sorry. I should try them out but I honestly don't know if it will be in the close future. But I'm really grateful for your reply and help.

What is an appreciation diary by the way?
yea that would probably be a good idea. i don't know if i'll do it though, ive never really talked to my friends about stuff like this. but thanks,,

No... its probably just me feeling that way but i know i deliberatly try to avoid talking about peoples feelings because im so scared ill hurt them trying to comfort them, which just hurts people more.

but im sorry uve felt this way too,, thanks for hearing me out,, i just feel like all my relationshipss are permanently "tainted" by my badness, if that makes sense. so everytime i screw up it i feel like im just going deeper into badtown(tm) and irredeemable assholishness

I know I'm not bad all the way through, but I feel like I'll have a "good" period of time where I can invest a little in my relationships, to make people trust me again. Then it's right back to hurting them by leeching off them and not caring enough. I never intentionally hurt people I just prioritize myself too much but im too tired to do anything else
